chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 13 (Legislative branch) houses Subch. III sections 13.61-13.75 (Lobbying Regulation), Wisconsin's lobbying-disclosure regime; WI Statutes are flat-chaptered, so this chapter URL is the title-level entry point.

notes: Wisconsin Statutes have no 'title' layer — chapters are the top-level division. Chapter 11 (Campaign financing) is a separate regime and intentionally excluded per pass-1 Rule 4.
